skills.description: Feynman teach-back tutor: the student explains a concept, the AI listens as a sincere naive audience and asks what it cannot follow — never explains for them. A six-stage spiral surfaces jargon black boxes and gaps, sends the student back to the exact textbook section, and closes with an understanding diagnostic report. Single entry `/feynman-diagnoser`. Activation needs no phrase-exact match: any message pairing a concept or topic with a teach-it-to-you intent or a check-my-understanding intent qualifies — shortened and embedded forms count. Representative full phrases: teach it back, check my understanding, Feynman technique, 我讲给你听, 检查我的理解, 费曼学习法, 费曼. Abbreviated / embedded forms equally trigger: let me explain, listen to my explanation, does my understanding sound right, am I understanding this right, 我讲讲, 讲一遍, 听我讲, 我讲一遍, 这样讲对吗, 我理解得对吗, 理解对不对, 这样理解对吗, 我想弄懂, 我想搞懂, 想真正理解.
skills.description_zh: 暨大学子的「讲懂检测」学习法助手。你把一个概念讲给 AI 听，AI 装作不懂一直追问，逼你讲不清的地方现原形，精准定位黑话和知识盲点；讲不清的会把你指回教材原文去补，最后给你一份理解诊断报告。告别「看着会、一讲就卡」，暨大同学自学/复习的真正复盘利器。
